problem_statement: FlowFalcon/ModernShop, already rebranded into the Kopi Rimba specialty-coffee roastery storefront (brand wordmark, Kopi Single Origin & Rempah Nusantara tagline, Seduh Cerita dari Kebun Nusantara hero, coffee-and-spice catalog across four categories, quick-view modal, about/newsletter/footer), is a static single-page site (index.html shell + styles.css + main.js rendering shop-data.json). The store already has a native category filter (#product-filter, the Semua / Kopi Single Origin / Alat Seduh / Rempah Nusantara / Cold Brew & Siap Minum chips) that filters the product grid, but the shopper gets NO feedback about how many items each category holds and the filter chip row spills off narrow phones. Complete and repair the store's own shop-by-category experience so it is consistent, responsive and actually wired: (a) add a live count readout (class 'shopfilter__readout', id 'shopfilter-readout') beside the native filter chip row that reads 'Menampilkan N dari 16 · <Kategori>' and STAYS IN SYNC with the grid as the shopper filters (initially 'Menampilkan 16 dari 16 · Semua Produk'); (b) add a cross-section 'Belanja per Kategori' summary label (class 'shopfilter-summary') to the product section, the featured-categories section AND the newsletter section so the shop-by-category framing is reachable across the whole page; (c) keep the filter chip row ('.shopfilter__chips') from overflowing the 390px mobile viewport (let the chips wrap / use a fluid row instead of a fixed-width non-wrapping row; do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden); and (d) keep the filter + product grid visually faithful to the reference Kopi Rimba palette (ivory #fbf3ea surface, amber #8a5a2b accent), not a collapsed off-palette (dark/charcoal) grid where the product cards overlap. Preserve the Kopi Rimba identity, navigation, hero, category filter, product grid, modal, about/newsletter/footer, local imagery, and the desktop layout.
required_content: Add a live count readout (class 'shopfilter__readout', id 'shopfilter-readout') beside the native #product-filter chip row that reads 'Menampilkan N dari 16 · <Kategori>' and updates as the shopper filters (e.g. clicking 'Kopi Single Origin' shows 'Menampilkan 4 dari 16 · Kopi Single Origin'); the initial state reads 'Menampilkan 16 dari 16 · Semua Produk'.

Add a shared 'Belanja per Kategori' summary label (class 'shopfilter-summary') to the product section, the featured-categories section AND the newsletter section so the shop-by-category framing appears consistently across the storefront, not only in the product section.

Keep the '.shopfilter__chips' filter chip row responsive so the mobile storefront has NO horizontal overflow at 390px (wrap the chips / fluid row). Do not clip the overflow with overflow-x:hidden; the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width.
Keep the desktop (1440px) layout free of horizontal overflow.

Style the shop-by-category filter and product grid to match the reference Kopi Rimba look (ivory #fbf3ea surface, amber #8a5a2b accent) — the rendered filter + grid must be visually faithful to the reference, not a collapsed or off-palette (dark/charcoal) grid where the product cards overlap.
Do not damage the existing Kopi Rimba branding, navigation, hero, category filter, product grid, quick-view modal, about/newsletter/footer content, or local imagery.
design_constraints: Preserve the Kopi Rimba identity: coffee-roastery wordmark, ivory/amber palette, category filter, product grid, quick-view modal, about/newsletter/footer.
Do not replace the page, the product grid, or the shop-by-category filter with a new app shell, external design system, or unrelated layout.
Do not remove the shop-by-category filter, the filter chip row, the live count readout, the cross-section summary label, the category filter, the product cards, or the footer.
Do not add npm dependencies, remote scripts, remote fonts, remote images, generated build outputs, or unrelated file churn.
The filter chip row and the product grid must fit within 1440px desktop and 390px mobile viewports without horizontal overflow, and must render in the Kopi Rimba ivory/amber palette.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial protect the full rebranded storefront shell after shop-data.json loads.
desktop_product_cards verifies the rebranded Kopi Rimba catalog in the default product grid.
desktop_category_filter clicks the Kopi Single Origin filter to verify the rebranded catalog still renders after category filtering.
desktop_search_results searches for Gayo to verify the rebranded catalog still renders after search.
desktop_product_modal opens the quick-view modal to verify the rebranded product detail.
mobile_product_cards verifies the rebranded catalog at 390px mobile width without overflow.
desktop_newsletter and desktop_about protect the rebranded newsletter and about/contact sections.
mobile_menu_toggle clicks the responsive menu toggle to confirm the mobile navigation still works.

change_completion: The shared 'Belanja per Kategori' summary label appears in the products, featured-categories and newsletter sections.
The mobile storefront has no horizontal overflow after the filter-row repair.
Clicking a category chip filters the real product grid AND updates the live '#shopfilter-readout' count (e.g. 'Menampilkan 4 dari 16 · Kopi Single Origin').
content_asset_continuity: The product grid stays grounded in the repo's local coffee/spice imagery; no external or placeholder media.
Existing Kopi Rimba brand, nav, hero, about, newsletter, and footer content are preserved.
design_consistency: The shop-by-category filter and product grid keep the Kopi Rimba ivory/amber palette and are visually faithful to the reference.
The same summary-label component is consistent across the three sections; the hero, product grid, and footer remain recognizable.
interaction_continuity: Clicking a category chip updates the shared '#shopfilter-readout' 'Menampilkan N dari 16 · <Kategori>' count on click (the post-click terminal state reflects the filtered category, not the initial 'Menampilkan 16 dari 16 · Semua Produk').
regression: The storefront retains its original Kopi Rimba branding, hero, and imagery.
No new dependency, remote asset, generated build artifact, or broad redesign is introduced.
responsive: The storefront has no horizontal overflow on the 390px mobile states.
The desktop states remain free of horizontal overflow.

metadata.design_goal: complete or refine a user workflow across one or more meaningful screens
metadata.source_repo_kind: Static dynamic commerce storefront with JSON-driven categories/products, product-card template, search, filters, quick-view modal, newsletter, contact/footer, and mobile menu.
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused runnable static commerce storefront whose entire brand, catalog, and theme are data-driven, making it a natural host for a full-storefront rebrand into a fresh fictional coffee-and-spice roastery while preserving the component system and interactions.

author_notes: Slot slot_262 targets commerce / experience_continuity / modify (Edit) at site scope, L3. Product-grade retrofit: full multi-section rebrand of the ModernShop demo into Kopi Rimba, verified with console/network runtime-health gates, cross-page DOM assertions on rebranded sections, no_horizontal_overflow, and text-signal checks. Baseline = original ModernShop demo (fails regression/completion/visible/forbidden/console/dom); bad = shallow hero+wordmark-only rebrand that keeps the demo catalog and remote assets (passes regression but fails completion/visible/forbidden/console/dom).
